modules.name: VRU–01 Deflection Yoke
modules.description: CV-controlled raster-bending video-bus processor

modules.name: VRU–02 Scan Processor
modules.description: Scan processor: luma lifts each scanline into a vector-monitor relief, on the shared CRT beam layer

modules.name: VRU–03 Scope Trace
modules.description: Audio/CV oscilloscope and Lissajous video-bus source

modules.name: VRU–04 Line Field
modules.description: Scanline heightfield video-bus processor

modules.name: VRU–05 Video Oscillator
modules.description: CV-controllable video oscillator preview and video-bus source

modules.name: VRU–06 Ramps
modules.description: Two-layer grayscale ramp, triangle, sine and square shape generator for the VRU video bus

modules.name: VRU–07 Video Player
modules.description: Local video file and YouTube playback source for the VRU video bus

modules.name: VRU–08 Syphon In
modules.description: macOS Syphon input source for the VRU video bus

modules.name: VRU–09 Color Lab
modules.description: Hue, saturation, contrast, posterize, solarize, and channel-swap video-bus processor

modules.name: VRU–10 Colorizer
modules.description: Four-stop luma-to-colour gradient processor with band quantizing for VRU video buses

modules.name: VRU–11 Wave Shaper
modules.description: RGB and luma folding, wrapping, quantizing, and mirroring processor

modules.name: VRU–12 Keyer
modules.description: Luma matte and color key output processor for VRU video buses

modules.name: VRU–13 Bus Mixer

modules.description: Video feedback processor: zoom, rotate, shift and hue-shift the previous frame back into the picture

modules.name: VRU–15 Freeze Frame
modules.description: Triggerable frame hold and strobe processor for VRU video buses

modules.name: VRU–16 Display
modules.description: Video-bus display monitor

modules.name: VRU–17 Syphon Out
modules.description: macOS Syphon output publisher for a VRU video bus

modules.name: VRU–18 Dual LFO Chaos
modules.description: Dual LFO and chaotic CV generator for modulating visual modules

modules.name: VRU–19 1V CV Out
modules.description: Calibrated CV scaler for 0-1V and +/-1V video-synth voltage ranges

modules.name: VRU–20 Rotator
modules.description: Turns, zooms and slides a whole picture: spin, pivot, edge modes, kaleidoscope folds and a clocked notch turn

modules.name: VRU–21 Shapes
modules.description: Draws one closed shape and lets voltages move it: sides, round, point, size, place, repeat, copies and melt, as a grey picture of distance from the edge

modules.name: VRU–22 Video Mixer
modules.description: Four pictures in, one out: per-input color, a fader, cut and timed take, dissolve, add or a wipe shaped by any picture, a soft key with fill and matte, a clock that walks the inputs, fade to black and a live gate for each picture

modules.name: VRU–23 Octoscillator
modules.description: Eight chaotic CV channels with 24 coordinate outputs and adjustable shared movement
